decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0002-euclid-accents, for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's thirteen OS 1.74 port sites became address, length and SHA-256 guards in build.json's 1.74 release. Its keep2 sites, which keep a stock opcode word, are written as the equivalent jsr sites (three, opcode 4eb9) and an lea %a1 site (opcode 43f9), so no stock opcode is retained.
mod.json's storage field (euclid_accent, scope track, 1 bit) became build.json's storage.
The OS 1.73 source and sites are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc and shared/live-track.s keep their paths relative to the source, so the .include lines in src/euclid-accents.s are unchanged.
